acceptance: a diagram-model JSON (<name>.diagram.json) is the single source of truth — nodes carry id / name / kind / summary and, where the kind implies members, rows; ownership is a parent nesting and every real dependency is an edge, never memory or a raw code read
the model was hardened by 3 diverse-lens Sextants returning JSON findings, applied deterministically by the Shaper until a round surfaced no new S1 (hard cap 3 rounds), not trusted from a single pass

built into ONE self-contained docs/diagrams/<name>/<name>.html via build-spec-diagram.mjs (model inlined, libraries from CDN, no sibling files); a malformed model, a dangling edge, a duplicate id, or a parent cycle fails the build loud

the render was captured with shot.mjs and the PNG was actually Read and judged — legible nodes, non-garish CVD-safe colours, no overlaps, minimal crossings, a generated legend, working select/panel — not trusted from the source

the encoding is automatic from the model: kind -> colour is stable and name-derived (a curated KIND_HUE override pins common kinds to conventional, well-separated hues, else a stable name-hash into the fixed OKLCH palette) + shape past the hue cap; the badge GLYPH is curated for common kinds with a generic fallback for the rest; domain -> translucent zone; a react/apex/lambda mix stays visually distinct

no THIN nodes: every node's detail panel is worth opening — a fuller description, real rows with a plain-language means, and a source ref, not a one-line summary; build-spec-diagram.mjs reports thin nodes and a detail panel was actually opened and judged
